post.description:
After search_tenders, to read one tender's full public notice.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

sections.description: Lazy tabs to fetch in addition to the basic information; default both.

tender_id_string.description: The tender_id_string exactly as returned by search_tenders (e.g. 'yCXTwlfa9SRZE2o67WnycQ=='), or a full DetailsForVisitor URL containing STenderId=.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Public detail of one tender by its tender_id_string (from search_tenders rows or a pasted /Tender/DetailsForVisitor?STenderId= URL): basic information (name, number, reference, purpose, document price, status, contract duration, insurance, type, agency, submission method, guarantees), the dates tab (enquiry deadline, offer deadline with time, opening date, expected award, work start; Gregorian and Hijri) and the classification tab (contractor classification field, execution place with regions and cities, activities, construction and maintenance works). Three GETs: DetailsForVisitor, GetTenderDatesViewComponenet, GetRelationsDetailsViewComponenet. All labels and values are Arabic as printed. An unknown or old-system id is not_found (the site redirects it to its login page).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |

activity_id.description:
Main activity id from list_lookups kind=activities.

Provider reference: minimum 1.

agency_code.description: 12-digit agency code from list_lookups kind=agencies. Pattern: ^[0-9]{12}$.

booklet_price_range.description:
ConditionaBookletRange band 0-6 as offered by the site's price filter.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 6.

category.description:
TenderCategory: 0 all, 2 active/open, 3 enquiries stage, 4 offers stage, 5 opening stage, 6 awarded, 8 finished. Omitted = the site's default (all).

Provider reference: allowed values ["0", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "8"].

page.description:
1-based page number. The response reports the total and the runner's `next_cursor` carries the next page number.

page_size.description:
Rows per page, 1-24 (the server caps every page at 24 rows).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 24; default 12.

published_within.description:
PublishDateId: 1 any time (default here), 2 last two days, 3 last week, 4 last month, 5 last three months (the site's own UI default).

Provider reference: allowed values ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5"]; default 1.

query.description: Free-text keyword (MultipleSearch): matched against tender name, number, agency.

200.description:
Search the public (visitor) tender list of Etimad, Saudi Arabia's government procurement portal: keyword, reference number, tender number, type, activity/sub-activity, agency, regions, status category, publish window, document-price band, sort and page. Returns the listing rows (ids, names, agency, type, status, fees in SAR, Gregorian and Hijri deadlines, remaining time, server clock) with the tender_id_string that get_tender needs. Data is Arabic-only as the site publishes it.
